subject: Prompt pack delivery, lanecard for acceptance, and ephemeral access proposal
messages:
From: Jordan Peck <jordan.peck@nimblecloud.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Ortiz <maya.ortiz@nimblecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial request — prompt pack + testcases for eval

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the throughput numbers looked promising. We're ready to move to a short evaluation, but before we schedule the run we'd like to exchange a set of test cases and the prompt pack. Two asks on our side: 1) confirm retention and deletion guarantees for assets we share, and 2) a brief lanecard that describes acceptance criteria so our QA and procurement teams can sign off quickly.

Can you send what you typically provide to partners for a 2-week eval (format, access model, restricted use terms)? We're targeting an internal sign-off by May 28.

Cheers,
Jordan
Jordan Peck
Head of Platform Engineering
NimbleCloud Inc.
[attachment: evaluation_scope_onepager.pdf (stub)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Peck <jordan.peck@nimblecloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial request — prompt pack + testcases for eval

Jordan — great to hear you have internal momentum. Attaching the prompt pack and manifest we usually send for short proofs-of-value. High level:

- Delivery: we provide a scoped prompt pack (zipped) and a CSV manifest of test cases.
- Access model: ephemeral Share link + time-limited S3 presigned URLs for large assets.
- Usage constraints: assets may be used only for the agreed evaluation (no redistribution, no training beyond the evaluation scope).
- Retention: by default we request destruction confirmation after 30 days from completion; for tighter controls we can arrange automatic deletion and audit logs for the assets we host.

Attached: promptpack_v2.zip, testcases_manifest.csv, NDA_Signed_NimbleCloud.pdf.

Proposed next steps (quick MAP):
1) You confirm acceptance criteria bullets below (we can adapt):
   - 95% pass rate on core intent tests OR no high-severity misclassifications in top-100 cases.
2) We stand up ephemeral access for 14 days (you get read-only assets).
3) Post-eval: destruction confirmation or transfer under a separate MPA.

If that works, Ben will send the lanecard and a one-page acceptance checklist. Can we lock the evaluation window: May 24 — June 7?

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: promptpack_v2.zip (stub), testcases_manifest.csv (stub), NDA_Signed_NimbleCloud.pdf (stub)]

From: Maya Ortiz <maya.ortiz@nimblecloud.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Peck <jordan.peck@nimblecloud.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial request — prompt pack + testcases for eval

Thanks Soojin — quick clarification from procurement/security:

- "No redistribution" is fine, but we need to confirm whether Redwood will retain copies of our testcases after the eval period. If you host them, we need a written guarantee of deletion (and a signed log).
- Can the assets be restricted to ephemeral credentials that expire automatically (we prefer no manual deletion requests)?
- On acceptance criteria: our QA team prefers a lanecard with clear pass/fail thresholds and a minimal reproduction example per test case.

We can accept May 24 — June 7 if the retention and ephemeral access model is explicit in writing. Also include who on Redwood will act as the data steward for this exchange.

Best,
Maya
Procurement Operations
NimbleCloud Inc.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Maya Ortiz <maya.ortiz@nimblecloud.com>, Jordan Peck <jordan.peck@nimblecloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial request — prompt pack + testcases for eval

Maya — thanks for the specific asks. Confirming what we can commit to for the 2-week eval: 

- Hosting & automatic deletion: Redwood will host the shared artifacts on a time-limited bucket and set automatic retention to purge objects 7 days after the eval window closes (i.e., automatic deletion on June 14). We will provide a signed deletion log (hash + timestamp) within 5 business days of purge.
- Ephemeral credentials: access will be via presigned URLs that expire at the end of the eval window; no long-lived copies will be issued. If you prefer, we can instead provide read-only transient SFTP credentials that are revoked automatically.
- Data steward: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.com) will be the point of contact for asset custody and will sign the destruction confirmation.
- Lanecard & acceptance checklist: attached below as a short lanecard draft. It includes pass/fail thresholds and a short reproduction snippet. We are happy to add a per-test minimal reproduction if you provide one or we can generate a canonical example for each test.

Action items: 
- Jordan/Maya: confirm acceptance criteria or send alternate thresholds by EOD May 23.
- Ben: will send the signed lanecard & one-page MAP and trigger the file share on May 24.

Thanks — we want to make this low friction.

— Soojin
[attachment: lanecard_draft.pdf (stub)]

From: Jordan Peck <jordan.peck@nimblecloud.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Ortiz <maya.ortiz@nimblecloud.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial request — prompt pack + testcases for eval

On Fri, May 21, 2027 at 10:15 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Maya — thanks for the specific asks. Confirming what we can commit to for the 2-week eval: 
> 
> - Hosting & automatic deletion: Redwood will host the shared artifacts on a time-limited bucket and set automatic retention to purge objects 7 days after the eval window closes (i.e., automatic deletion on June 14). We will provide a signed deletion log (hash + timestamp) within 5 business days of purge.
> - Ephemeral credentials: access will be via presigned URLs that expire at the end of the eval window; no long-lived copies will be issued. If you prefer, we can instead provide read-only transient SFTP credentials that are revoked automatically.
> - Data steward: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.com) will be the point of contact for asset custody and will sign the destruction confirmation.
> - Lanecard & acceptance checklist: attached below as a short lanecard draft.

That all looks good. We confirm the MAP and the acceptance thresholds below:
- Primary pass threshold: >= 92% for intent accuracy on the core 200 testcases.
- No high-severity failures in the top-50 priority tests.

We accept the retention schedule and automatic purge on June 14. Please proceed with the file share on May 24 and send the presigned URLs to me and Maya. Once we receive the lanecard doc from Ben we'll route to QA for final sign-off.

Jordan
Head of Platform Engineering
NimbleCloud Inc.
